name: room
text: Room opened — goal: creators: Build PACKAGES + enrich tabs + draft elements; every one labeled 'Created by EXCAVA' + tes

name: Forge
text: I propose we start by creating a new package for the "Introduction to Excava" module, which will include 5 tabs and 10 draft elements. I'll create a new directory named `excava-intro` and add a `README.md` file with the label 'Created by EXCAVA'. To begin, I'll run the command `mkdir excava-intro && touch excava-intro/README.md` to set up the basic structure. Next, I'll add the initial content to the `README.md` file, including a brief overview of the module and its objectives.

name: Vet
text: Hold on, Forge, I'm not convinced that creating a new directory with a `README.md` file is sufficient to meet our quality standards. Can you provide evidence that the `excava-intro` package will be properly structured and scalable to accommodate the 5 tabs and 10 draft elements you're proposing? What metrics or benchmarks will you use to ensure that the package is truly "enriched" and not just a shallow collection of files?
